local function sum_loop(n)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, n do total = total + i end
    return total
end
local function sum_formula(n) return n * (n + 1) / 2 end
local function measure(fn, n, repeats)
    local start = os.clock(); local result
    for _ = 1, repeats do result = fn(n) end
    return result, os.clock() - start
end
local a, ta = measure(sum_loop, 10000, 100)
local b, tb = measure(sum_formula, 10000, 100)
assert(a == b)
print(a, ta >= 0, tb >= 0)
